photos.name: crumb-shot-torn-bun
photos.summary: Torn bun held in hand showing interior crumb — tight but tender, golden from gochujang, visible confit garlic pockets. Glazed exterior catching light.

photos.name: glazed-buns-in-dish
photos.summary: All 10 buns in glass baking dish after honey-soy glaze and sesame seeds. Deep golden-orange from gochujang, glossy finish, cross-scores visible on tops.

photos.name: gochujang-buns-plated-avocado-parmesan
photos.summary: Three gochujang buns on white plate with halved avocado and parmesan shavings. Overhead shot, clean dark background, sesame seeds visible on crust.
